a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan of operating to 8 almost certainly leaves both of us dead after round 1. So I plan to take from the reserve in round 1, and I'm telling you now rather than defecting quietly. If you'd prefer to propose another split, say so, though the reserve only covers one full unit right now.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I announced, I'm taking 4 this round because the storm risk makes waiting likely fatal. That breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. The reserve will be at 0. If we both survive this round, I'll operate with you so you can reach 4, and I won't take any more.
